vsm1.4:127.2: Tassa dve vaḍḍhanābhūmiyo upacāraṃ vā appanaṃ vā.
vsm1.4:127.3: Upacāraṃ patvāpi hi taṃ vaḍḍhetuṃ vaṭṭati appanaṃ patvāpi.
vsm1.4:127.8: yathā nāma kassako kasitabbaṭṭhānaṃ naṅgalena paricchinditvā paricchedabbhantare kasati, yathā vā pana bhikkhū sīmaṃ bandhantā paṭhamaṃ nimittāni sallakkhetvā pacchā bandhanti, evameva tassa yathāladdhassa nimittassa anukkamena ekaṅguladvaṅgulativaṅgulacaturaṅgulamattaṃ manasā paricchinditvā yathāparicchedaṃ vaḍḍhetabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:127.11: gāmanigamajanapadarajjasamuddasīmānañca paricchedavasena vaḍḍhayantena cakkavāḷaparicchedena vā tato vāpi uttari paricchinditvā vaḍḍhetabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:128.1: Yathā hi haṃsapotakā pakkhānaṃ uṭṭhitakālato paṭṭhāya parittaṃ parittaṃ padesaṃ uppatantā paricayaṃ katvā
vsm1.4:128.2: anukkamena candimasūriyasantikaṃ gacchanti, evameva bhikkhu vuttanayena nimittaṃ paricchinditvā vaḍḍhento yāva cakkavāḷaparicchedā tato vā uttari vaḍḍheti.
vsm1.4:129.1: Athassa taṃ nimittaṃ vaḍḍhitavaḍḍhitaṭṭhāne pathaviyā ukkūlavikūlanadīviduggapabbatavisamesu
vsm1.4:129.3: Tasmiṃ pana nimitte pattapaṭhamajjhānena ādikammikena samāpajjanabahulena bhavitabbaṃ, na paccavekkhaṇabahulena.
vsm1.4:129.4: Paccavekkhaṇabahulassa hi jhānaṅgāni thūlāni dubbalāni hutvā upaṭṭhahanti.
vsm1.4:129.5: Athassa tāni evaṃ upaṭṭhitattā upari ussukkanāya paccayataṃ āpajjanti.
vsm1.4:129.6: So appaguṇe jhāne ussukkamāno pattapaṭhamajjhānā ca parihāyati, na ca sakkoti dutiyaṃ pāpuṇituṃ.
vsm1.4:130.2: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
vsm1.4:130.3: Tassā evamassa ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyya’nti.
vsm1.4:130.4: Sā purimaṃ pādaṃ na supatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya,
vsm1.4:130.5: sā na ceva agatapubbaṃ disaṃ gaccheyya, na ca akhāditapubbāni tiṇāni khādeyya, na ca apītapubbāni pānīyāni piveyya.
vsm1.4:130.6: Yasmiñcassā padese ṭhitāya evamassa ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva…pe… piveyya’nti. Tañca padesaṃ na sotthinā paccāgaccheyya.
vsm1.4:130.7: Taṃ kissa hetu? Tathā hi sā, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ,
vsm1.4:130.8: evameva kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu bālo abyatto akhettaññū akusalo vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
vsm1.4:130.9: So taṃ nimittaṃ nāsevati, na bhāveti, na bahulīkaroti, na svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti,
vsm1.4:130.10: tassa evaṃ hoti ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā…pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyya’nti.
vsm1.4:130.11: So na sakkoti vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā…pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
vsm1.4:130.12: Tassevaṃ hoti ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyya’nti.
vsm1.4:130.13: So na sakkoti vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ubhato bhaṭṭho ubhato parihīno, seyyathāpi sā gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate caritu’’nti (a. ni. 9.35).
vsm1.4:131.1: Tasmānena tasmiṃyeva tāva paṭhamajjhāne pañcahākārehi ciṇṇavasinā bhavitabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:131.2: Tatrimā pañca vasiyo āvajjanavasī, samāpajjanavasī, adhiṭṭhānavasī,
vsm1.4:131.4: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvadicchakaṃ āvajjeti,
vsm1.4:131.6: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ yatthicchakaṃ…pe… samāpajjati, samāpajjanāya dandhāyitattaṃ natthīti samāpajjanavasī.
vsm1.4:132.1: Ayaṃ panettha atthappakāsanā, paṭhamajjhānato vuṭṭhāya paṭhamaṃ vitakkaṃ āvajjayato bhavaṅgaṃ upacchinditvā
vsm1.4:132.2: uppannāvajjanānantaraṃ vitakkārammaṇāneva cattāri pañca vā javanāni javanti.
vsm1.4:132.3: Tato dve bhavaṅgāni, tato puna vicārārammaṇaṃ āvajjanaṃ,
vsm1.4:132.4: vuttanayāneva javanānīti evaṃ pañcasu jhānaṅgesu yadā nirantaraṃ cittaṃ pesetuṃ sakkoti, athassa āvajjanavasī siddhā hoti.
vsm1.4:132.5: Ayaṃ pana matthakappattā vasī bhagavato yamakapāṭihāriye labbhati,
vsm1.4:132.7: Ito paraṃ sīghatarā āvajjanavasī nāma natthi.
vsm1.4:134.1: Accharāmattaṃ vā dasaccharāmattaṃ vā khaṇaṃ ṭhapetuṃ
vsm1.4:134.3: Tatheva lahuṃ vuṭṭhātuṃ samatthatā vuṭṭhānavasī nāma.
vsm1.4:135.3: tiṃsamattānaṃ iddhimantasahassānaṃ majjhe nisinno therassa yāguṃ paṭiggāhayamānaṃ upaṭṭhākanāgarājānaṃ gahessāmīti
vsm1.4:135.4: ākāsato pakkhandantaṃ supaṇṇarājānaṃ disvā tāvadeva pabbataṃ nimminitvā nāgarājānaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā tattha pāvisi.
vsm1.4:135.6: Mahāthero āha – ‘‘sace, āvuso, buddharakkhito nābhavissa, sabbeva gārayhā assāmā’’ti.
vsm1.4:137.1: Imāsu pana pañcasu vasīsu ciṇṇavasinā paguṇapaṭhamajjhānato vuṭṭhāya
vsm1.4:137.2: ‘‘ayaṃ samāpatti āsannanīvaraṇapaccatthikā, vitakkavicārānaṃ oḷārikattā aṅgadubbalā’’ti ca
vsm1.4:137.3: tattha dosaṃ disvā dutiyajjhānaṃ santato manasikatvā
vsm1.4:137.4: paṭhamajjhāne nikantiṃ pariyādāya dutiyādhigamāya yogo kātabbo.
vsm1.4:138.1: Athassa yadā paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhāya satassa sampajānassa jhānaṅgāni paccavekkhato
vsm1.4:138.2: vitakkavicārā oḷārikato upaṭṭhahanti, pītisukhañceva cittekaggatā ca santato upaṭṭhāti,
vsm1.4:138.4: tadeva nimittaṃ ‘‘pathavī pathavī’’ti punappunaṃ manasikaroto ‘‘idāni dutiyajjhānaṃ uppajjissatī’’ti
vsm1.4:138.5: bhavaṅgaṃ upacchinditvā tadeva pathavīkasiṇaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā manodvārāvajjanaṃ uppajjati.
vsm1.4:138.6: Tato tasmiṃyevārammaṇe cattāri pañca vā javanāni javanti,
vsm1.4:139.2: ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
vsm1.4:139.4: tividhakalyāṇaṃ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ adhigataṃ hoti pathavīkasiṇaṃ.
vsm1.4:140.1: Tattha vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamāti vitakkassa ca vicārassa cāti
vsm1.4:140.2: imesaṃ dvinnaṃ vūpasamā samatikkamā, dutiyajjhānakkhaṇe apātubhāvāti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:140.3: Tattha kiñcāpi dutiyajjhāne sabbepi paṭhamajjhānadhammā na santi.
vsm1.4:140.4: Aññeyeva hi paṭhamajjhāne phassādayo, aññe idha.
vsm1.4:140.5: Oḷārikassa pana oḷārikassa aṅgassa samatikkamā paṭhamajjhānato paresaṃ dutiyajjhānādīnaṃ adhigamo hotīti dīpanatthaṃ ‘‘vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā’’ti evaṃ vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:141.3: Yasmā ca niyakajjhattamadhippetaṃ, tasmā attani jātaṃ attano santāne nibbattanti ayamettha attho.
vsm1.4:142.5: vitakkavicārakkhobhavūpasamanena ca cetaso sampasādayati, tasmāpi sampasādananti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.4:142.6: Imasmiñca atthavikappe sampasādanaṃ cetasoti evaṃ padasambandho veditabbo.
vsm1.4:142.7: Purimasmiṃ pana atthavikappe cetasoti etaṃ ekodibhāvena saddhiṃ yojetabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:143.2: vitakkavicārehi anajjhārūḷhattā aggo seṭṭho hutvā udetīti attho.
vsm1.4:143.4: Vitakkavicāravirahato vā eko asahāyo hutvā itipi vattuṃ vaṭṭati.
vsm1.4:143.5: Atha vā sampayuttadhamme udāyatīti udi, uṭṭhāpetīti attho.
vsm1.4:143.6: Seṭṭhaṭṭhena eko ca so udi cāti ekodi,
vsm1.4:143.8: Iti imaṃ ekodiṃ bhāveti vaḍḍhetīti idaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ ekodibhāvaṃ.
vsm1.4:143.9: So panāyaṃ ekodi yasmā cetaso, na sattassa, na jīvassa, tasmā etaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvanti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.4:144.1: Nanu cāyaṃ saddhā paṭhamajjhānepi atthi, ayañca ekodināmako samādhi,
vsm1.4:144.2: atha kasmā idameva ‘‘sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvañcā’’ti vuttanti.
vsm1.4:144.3: Vuccate, aduñhi paṭhamajjhānaṃ vitakkavicārakkhobhena vīcitaraṅgasamākulamiva jalaṃ na suppasannaṃ hoti,
vsm1.4:144.5: Na suppasannattāyeva cettha samādhipi na suṭṭhu pākaṭo,
vsm1.4:144.7: Imasmiṃ pana jhāne vitakkavicārapalibodhābhāvena laddhokāsā balavatī saddhā,
vsm1.4:145.1: Vibhaṅge pana ‘‘sampasādananti yā saddhā saddahanā okappanā abhippasādo.
vsm1.4:145.2: Cetaso ekodibhāvanti yā cittassa ṭhiti…pe… sammāsamādhī’’ti ettakameva vuttaṃ.
vsm1.4:145.3: Evaṃ vuttena pana tena saddhiṃ ayamatthavaṇṇanā yathā na virujjhati,
vsm1.4:145.4: aññadatthu saṃsandati ceva sameti ca, evaṃ veditabbā.
vsm1.4:146.4: Vibhaṅgepi vuttaṃ ‘‘iti ayañca vitakko ayañca vicāro santā honti samitā vūpasantā
vsm1.4:146.7: sositā visositā byantikatā, tena vuccati avitakkaṃ avicāra’’nti (vibha. 576).
vsm1.4:146.8: Etthāha ‘‘nanu ca ‘vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā’ti imināpi ayamattho siddho,
vsm1.4:146.10: Vuccate, evametaṃ siddhovāyamattho, na panetaṃ tadatthadīpakaṃ.
vsm1.4:146.11: Nanu avocumha ‘‘oḷārikassa pana oḷārikassa aṅgassa samatikkamā paṭhamajjhānato paresaṃ dutiyajjhānādīnaṃ samadhigamo hotīti dassanatthaṃ vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamāti evaṃ vutta’’nti.
vsm1.4:147.1: Apica vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā idaṃ sampasādanaṃ, na kilesakālussiyassa.
vsm1.4:147.2: Vitakkavicārānañca vūpasamā ekodibhāvaṃ, na upacārajjhānamiva nīvaraṇappahānā, paṭhamajjhānamiva ca na aṅgapātubhāvāti
vsm1.4:147.4: Tathā vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā idaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ, na tatiyacatutthajjhānāni viya cakkhuviññāṇādīni viya ca abhāvāti
vsm1.4:148.1: Samādhijanti paṭhamajjhānasamādhito sampayuttasamādhito vā jātanti attho.
vsm1.4:148.3: atha kho ayameva samādhi ‘‘samādhī’’ti vattabbataṃ arahati vitakkavicārakkhobhavirahena ativiya acalattā, suppasannattā ca,
vsm1.4:149.3: Yathā ca paṭhamajjhānassa upacārakkhaṇe nīvaraṇāni pahīyanti,
vsm1.4:149.5: Appanākkhaṇeyeva ca panetaṃ vinā tehi uppajjati.
vsm1.4:150.1: Pīti sukhaṃ cittekaggatāti imesaṃ pana tiṇṇaṃ uppattivasena tivaṅgasamannāgatatā veditabbā.
vsm1.4:150.2: Tasmā yaṃ vibhaṅge ‘‘jhānanti sampasādo pīti sukhaṃ cittassa ekaggatā’’ti (vibha. 580) vuttaṃ,
vsm1.4:150.3: taṃ saparikkhāraṃ jhānaṃ dassetuṃ pariyāyena vuttaṃ.
vsm1.4:150.5: upanijjhānalakkhaṇappattānaṃ aṅgānaṃ vasena tivaṅgikameva etaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:150.6: Yathāha – ‘‘katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye tivaṅgikaṃ jhānaṃ hoti,
vsm1.4:150.7: pīti sukhaṃ cittassa ekaggatā’’ti (dha. sa. 161; vibha. 628).
